title: Not the best quality but my geek self still LOVES it!
text: Runs small, is a bit short, and shrunk after washing.... BUT I knew this would probably be the case so I purchased a size larger and I really love getting a "surprise" Star Trek shirt every month!  The designs are original and I have received lots of compliments on it so far.  The fabric is a not too think, and has a bit of stretch. I'm satisfied!
label: positive
